plain.li: [greet,us] Hello there, have you got a moment to talk?
[greet,us] Welcome to the colony, I'm glad to finally meet you.
[greet,us] I don't think we've talked yet, have we?
[greet,us,morning] Good morning, did you sleep well out here?
[greet,us,evening] Evening, mind if I keep you company a while?
[greet,us,theirLowtech] Be welcome at our fire, traveller.
[chat,them] It's a long road to here, but a pretty one.
[chat,them] Your people keep a tidy place, I'll give you that.
[chat,them] We don't see many settlements this far out.
[chat,them,rain] At least the rain keeps the dust down on the road.
[chat,them,cold] I'd forgotten how cold it gets out here.
[chat,them,theirLowtech] Your walls are strange to us, but they look strong.
[chat,them,theirHightech] You've done a lot with very little here.
[chat,us] So what brings you all the way out to us?
[chat,us] We don't get many visitors, so this is a treat.
[chat,us] Tell me something about yourself, I'm curious.
[chat,us,summer] It's been a hot one, hasn't it?
[endwarm,them] I'm glad we talked, truly.
[endwarm,them] You're good company, you know that?
[endwarm,them] I'll remember this when I'm home.
[endgood,them] That was a pleasant talk.
[endgood,them] Thank you for the company.
[endplain,them] Well, I should get back to my people.
[endplain,them] Good talking to you.
[endcool,them] I think we've said all there is to say.
[endcool,them] Right, well, I'll leave you to it.
[endsour,them] I don't think we'll be friends, you and I.
[endsour,them] That's enough talk for one day.
[notnow,them] Not now, please.
[notnow,them] Another time, I'm in no state for it.
[notnow,them] Can't you see I'm busy?
[homeask,us] What's it like back in {TOWN}?
[homeask,us] Any news from your part of the world?
[homeask,us] How are things at home for your people?
[home,them] Times have been hard and easy, the way they always are.
[home,them] The roads around {TOWN} are busier than they used to be.
[home,them] My people talk about little else these days.
[home,us] And how are your people taking it?
[home,us] That's worth knowing, thank you.
[hometold,them] There, that's all the news I carry.
[hometold,them] You'll want to remember all that, I think.
[homenothing,them] I'd rather keep home's business to myself.
[homenothing,them] Nothing worth the telling, I'm afraid.
[mealask,us] Will you eat with me, there's food enough for two?
[mealask,us] Come and have a meal with me, you must be hungry after the road.
[mealyes,them] I'd like that very much, thank you.
[mealyes,them] A meal at someone else's table, that's a kindness.
[mealno,them] Thank you, but I'll eat with my own people.
[mealno,them] I'm not hungry, but thank you.
[mealtalk] This is good, who made it?
[mealtalk] Pass the salt, would you?
[mealtalk,them,theirLowtech] We'd sing over a meal like this at home.
[mealend,them] That was a fine meal, thank you.
[mealend,them] I'll sleep well after that.
[drinkask,us] Have a drink with me, it's on the colony.
[drinkask,us] I've got a bottle put by, will you share it?
[drinkyes,them] I won't say no to that.
[drinkyes,them] Just the one, then.
[drinkno,them] I don't drink, but thank you all the same.
[drinkno,them] Not today, thank you.
[drinktalk] To your health, then.
[drinktalk] That's stronger than it looks.
[drinkend,them] Good stuff, your people brew it well.
[drinkend,them] Thanks for the drink, friend.
[gift,us] This is for you, with the colony's thanks.
[gift,us] I thought you might like this.
[gift,us] Something for the road, take it.
[giftsuits,them] How did you know, this is just what I'd have wanted.
[giftsuits,them] Oh, this is perfect, thank you.
[giftthanks,them] That's very kind of you.
[giftthanks,them] I'll take good care of it.
[giftno,them] I'm sorry, I can't accept that.
[giftno,them] That's not something I can take, forgive me.
[wordask,us] Would you speak well of us when you're home?
[wordask,us] Put in a good word for us with your people, would you?
[wordyes,them] I'll tell them what I've seen here, and it was good.
[wordyes,them] You have my word, they'll hear well of you.
[wordno,them] I'll tell them what I saw, nothing more.
[wordno,them] I don't make promises for my people.
[letter,us] Would you take this letter home with you?
[letter,us] This needs to reach {TOWN}, could you carry it?
[letteryes,them] It'll be in the right hands before long.
[letteryes,them] Leave it with me, I'll see it gets there.
[teachask,us] Could you show me how you do it, just for an hour?
[teachask,us] I'd love to learn from you, if you'd teach me.
[teachyes,them] Come on then, I'll show you what I know.
[teachyes,them] Watch closely, I'll only show you once.
[teachno,them] I'm not a teacher, and I haven't the time.
[teachno,them] That's not something I give away.
[lesson,them] No, slower, and keep your hands steady.
[lesson,them] That's it, you're getting the feel of it.
[lesson,them] Try it again, but this time watch me first.
[lessonask,us] Like this, or am I doing it wrong?
[lessonask,us] Why do you do it that way round?
[lessondone,them] You learn quickly, keep practising.
[lessondone,them] That's enough for today, you did well.
[bringask,us] Next time your people come, could they bring us something?
[bringask,us] We're short of a few things, could your people help?
[bringyes,them] I'll ask for it, and you'll have it next time.
[bringyes,them] Consider it done, we'll bring it.
[bringno,them] We've little enough to spare ourselves.
[bringno,them] I can't promise what isn't mine to give.
[brought,them] Here's what you asked for, as promised.
[brought,them] We didn't forget, this is for you.
[inviteask,us] Why not stay with us, there's a place for you here?
[inviteask,us] You'd be welcome here for good, you know.
[inviteyes,them] You know, I think I will.
[inviteyes,them] I've been hoping someone would ask.
[inviteno,them] My place is with my people, but thank you.
[inviteno,them] I couldn't leave them, not now.
[befriend,us] Walk with me a while, I'd like to know you better.
[befriend,us] Tell me about yourself, I mean it.
[befriend,us] I'm glad you came back, I hoped you would.
[friends,us] Whenever you're this way, you've a friend here.
[friends,us] Come back soon, friend.
[court,us] I've been thinking about you since you got here.
[court,us] Would you walk with me, just the two of us?
[courttalk,them] You're very forward, aren't you?
[courttalk,us] I mean every word of it.
[courttalk] I like the way you laugh.
[courtyes,them] I'd hoped you'd say something like that.
[courtyes,them] I think about you too, you know.
[courtno,them] I'm flattered, but no.
[courtno,them] I don't feel that way about you, I'm sorry.
[lovers,us] I don't care how far apart we live.
[lovers,us] Come back to me soon.
[faith,us] Tell me about your faith, I've wondered about it.
[faith,us] What do your people believe, if you don't mind me asking?
[faithtalk] That's not how we see it at all.
[faithtalk] There's more truth in that than you'd think.
[faithtalk,them] We were taught that from the cradle.
[faithcloser,them] It's good to meet someone who keeps the same faith.
[faithcloser,them] We're of one mind, you and I.
[faithsoftened,them] You've given me something to think about.
[faithsoftened,them] I'm not sure I believe it the way I did this morning.
[faithagreed,them] We'll have to agree to differ, then.
[faithagreed,them] Each to their own, I suppose.
[faithhardened,them] I won't hear my faith spoken of like that.
[faithhardened,them] You're wrong, and I'll pray you see it one day.
[sparask,us] Fancy a friendly bout, nothing serious?
[sparask,us] Show me how they fight where you come from.
[sparyes,them] Alright, but don't cry when you lose.
[sparyes,them] A little practice never hurt anyone, mostly.
[sparno,them] I'd rather not, thank you.
[sparno,them] I didn't come here to fight.
[sparbegin,us] Fists only, and we stop when one of us says so.
[sparbegin,us] Ready when you are.
[sparwin] Good bout, you nearly had me.
[sparwin] Keep your guard up next time.
[sparlose] Alright, alright, you win this one.
[sparlose] I'll get you next time.
[provoke,us] Your people are thieves and everyone knows it.
[provoke,us] You've got a nerve, showing your face here.
[provoke,us] Go home, nobody wants you here.
[provoked,them] What did you just say to me?
[provoked,them] Say that again, I dare you.
[provoked,us] You heard me.
[provokefight,them] Right, that's it!
[provokefight,them] You'll regret that.
[provokecalm,them] I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
[provokecalm,them] My people will hear of this.
[duelask,us] I challenge you, by your own people's ways.
[duelask,us] Let's settle this with honour, you and I.
[duelask,us,theirLowtech] By the old ways, I call you out.
[duelyes,them] I accept, and may the better one win.
[duelyes,them] So be it, let them all watch.
[duelno,them] There's no honour in this, I refuse.
[duelno,them] I won't fight you, not today.
[duelsalute,us] On my word, we fight by the terms.
[duelsalute,us] Ready yourself.
[duelwin] You fought well, there's no shame in it.
[duelwin] It's settled, then.
[duelyield] Enough, I yield.
[duelyield] You have it, I yield.
[watch] Go on, get in there!
[watch] Look at them go.
[watch] Mind the blade, mind the blade.
[watch] I can hardly bear to watch.
